propositions: Detached compaction sweep worker can crash or be killed between retire-rename and git commit, leaving the tracker working tree dirty with uncommitted snapshots and stray tracked deletions that wedge subsequent reconverge operations

Compaction fold must be made crash-atomic by writing an intent journal before mutation, ordering snapshot-write → renames → commit as a single unit, and implementing rollback with snapshot retention on incomplete reverse-renames to prevent data loss

Recovery process must discriminate between three journal states: snapshot already in HEAD (discard journal only), abandoned partial fold with uncommitted artifacts (revert and discard), and snapshot gone from disk (discard without touching ticket files), while treating transient git probe failures as indeterminate to avoid misclassifying landed folds

Journal write failure must cause fold to refuse without mutating the store, while successful folds must execute entirely within a single locked section to minimize dirty-tree window between intermediate steps
Crash injection at each step boundary (journal write, snapshot write, renames, commit) must leave the store convergent to clean on next sweep entry with zero event loss and zero stray artifacts
